oscillation-period.def: The time for one complete cycle of an oscillation, T, in seconds; the frequency is f = 1/T, in hertz.

spring-mass-period.def: The period of a block of mass m on a spring of constant k: T = 2π√(m/k). It does not depend on the amplitude or on g.

pendulum-period.def: The period of a simple pendulum of length ℓ at small angles: T = 2π√(ℓ/g). It does not depend on the bob's mass.
